##### Project general facts

Samana Skyros by Samana Developers is a stunning residential property that captures the essence of Greece in Dubai. This development is designed around the philosophy of living every day as if it were a holiday. From lush greenery to serene water features and private pools, every aspect of Samana Skyros is inspired by the tranquility and beauty of a tropical vacation, offering an escape from the stresses of everyday life.

Residents enjoy a wealth of world-class amenities designed for leisure and well-being. The main pool is complemented by private pools inside select apartments, a luxurious and large leisure pool deck, and a kids' pool. The rooftop offers an outdoor cinema, a basketball court, a jogging track, and a lounge. Fitness enthusiasts appreciate the indoor health club, outdoor and rooftop gyms, sauna and steam room, while a kids' play area ensures fun for the whole family. Every element is crafted to create a peaceful yet vibrant lifestyle.

Every residence at Samana Skyros features stylish décor with striking furnishings, creating simply elegant and welcoming spaces. The interiors are designed as a serene retreat, with stylish and functional layouts that maximize comfort and natural light. The thoughtful design and high-quality finishes ensure each home is both beautiful and practical, embodying the laid-back, stylish vibe of a Greek island escape.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in Arjan, this exceptional location offers the perfect balance of convenience and connectivity. The community has everything needed for everyday life nearby, including schools, medical facilities, convenience stores, and shopping centers, with easy access to major locations. The area is strategically positioned close to Dubai's key destinations, making it an ideal choice for those seeking a peaceful yet connected lifestyle.

The location is distinguished by its proximity to major attractions including Dubai Miracle Garden, Mall of the Emirates, Dubai Marina, Burj Al Arab, Palm Jumeirah, Dubai Mall, Burj Khalifa, and Dubai International Airport. Direct access to Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road ensures seamless connectivity to all parts of the city.

For those seeking a residence that embodies the essence of a Greek holiday, modern convenience, and a prime Dubai address, Arjan delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of lush greenery, world-class amenities, and strategic connectivity makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of city living — tranquil, connected and effortlessly refined.
